name: @omadia/transcription-adapter-openai
description: OpenAI adapter for the omadia transcription@1 capability (byte5ai/omadia#584). Implements the @omadia/transcription-api TranscriptionService via the openai SDK: batch through client.audio.transcriptions.create (model gpt-transcribe, one segment per file, timing 'none'); transcribeStream is a not-implemented stub until the realtime follow-up PR (gpt-live-transcribe via OpenAIRealtimeWS). ONE package houses both providers — same vendor, key, client construction, and admin surface. All transcription-side openai SDK knowledge lives here (ESLint no-restricted-imports allowlist); deliberately NO dependency on @omadia/llm-adapter-openai.
